title: Greek Citrus Cornmeal Cakes
description: A gluten-free breakfast or snack option, these cornmeal cakes are infused with the brightness of citrus and the warmth of spices. Perfect for a quick morning treat.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, yogurt, orange zest, egg, honey, oregano, and salt.
Heat the melted butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the cornmeal mixture into the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to set.
Flip the cakes and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until golden brown.
Transfer the cakes to a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, until cooked through.
